create_experiment_config: create an ExperimentConfig dataclass instance with code instructions, entry file, and selection metric
create_experiment_config_with_eval: create an ExperimentConfig with evaluation settings including eval_fname, eval_metric_types, and eval_selection_metric
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass instance with nodes, gpus_per_node, cpus_per_task, and job_ttl

review_experiment_config_fields: review the ExperimentConfig dataclass fields including metric constraints, eval settings, and max_retries
